nights.title: 5 SECONDS OF SUMMER: EVERYONE’S A STAR! WORLD TOUR
nights.name: 5 Seconds of Summer
nights.extract: 5 Seconds of Summer, often shortened to 5SOS, are an Australian pop rock band formed in Sydney in 2011. The group consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Luke Hemmings, lead guitarist Michael Clifford, bassist Calum Hood, and drummer Ashton Irwin. Originally beginning their career as YouTube celebrities, they rose to international fame while touring with English-Irish boy band One Direction on their Take Me Home Tour. Since 2014, 5 Seconds of Summer have sold more than 10 million albums, sold over 2 million concert tickets worldwide, and have attained more than 7 billion streams of their songs on music streaming services, making them one of the most successful Australian musical acts

en.who: 5 Seconds of Summer, often shortened to 5SOS, are an Australian pop rock band formed in Sydney in 2011. The group consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Luke Hemmings, lead guitarist Michael Clifford, bassist Calum Hood, and drummer Ashton Irwin.
facts: Originally beginning their career as YouTube celebrities, they rose to international fame while touring with English-Irish boy band One Direction on their Take Me Home Tour.

Since 2014, 5 Seconds of Summer have sold more than 10 million albums, sold over 2 million concert tickets worldwide, and have attained more than 7 billion streams of their songs on music streaming services.

de.who: 5 Seconds of Summer, kurz 5SOS, sind eine australische Pop-Rock-Band, die 2011 in Sydney gegründet wurde. Die Gruppe besteht aus Leadsänger und Rhythmusgitarrist Luke Hemmings, Leadgitarrist Michael Clifford, Bassist Calum Hood und Schlagzeuger Ashton Irwin.
facts: Ursprünglich als YouTube-Stars gestartet, wurden sie international bekannt, als sie mit der englisch-irischen Boyband One Direction auf deren Take Me Home Tour unterwegs waren.

Seit 2014 haben 5 Seconds of Summer mehr als 10 Millionen Alben verkauft, über 2 Millionen Konzerttickets weltweit abgesetzt und mehr als 7 Milliarden Streams ihrer Songs auf Musik-Streaming-Diensten erreicht.

tr.who: 5 Seconds of Summer, kısaca 5SOS, 2011 yılında Sydney'de kurulan bir Avustralyalı pop rock grubudur. Grup; baş vokalist ve ritim gitaristi Luke Hemmings, solo gitarist Michael Clifford, basçı Calum Hood ve davulcu Ashton Irwin'den oluşmaktadır.
facts: YouTube ünlüleri olarak başlayan kariyerlerinde, İngiliz-İrlandalı erkek grubu One Direction'ın Take Me Home Tour turnesinde onlarla birlikte sahneye çıkmaları sayesinde uluslararası üne kavuştular.

2014'ten bu yana 5 Seconds of Summer 10 milyondan fazla albüm sattı, dünya genelinde 2 milyonun üzerinde konser bileti sattı ve şarkılarının müzik akış platformlarındaki dinlenme sayısı 7 milyardan fazla oldu.

nights.title: JOJI: SOLARIS
nights.name: Joji
nights.extract: George Kusunoki Miller , known professionally as Joji, is a Japanese-Australian singer, songwriter, rapper, comedian, and former internet personality. His music has been described as a mix between R&B, lo-fi, and trip-hop. Miller also created The Filthy Frank Show on YouTube in 2011, a comedy web-series while he was still living in Japan, playing the oddball characters Filthy Frank and Pink Guy.

nights.title: Sienna Spiro: My House Tour
nights.name: Sienna Spiro
nights.extract: Sienna Ann Spiro is an English singer-songwriter and record producer. Known for her distinct, powerful voice, she began sharing viral singing videos on TikTok in 2021. She started releasing music in 2024, including "Maybe", which became her debut on the UK Singles Chart. She released Sink Now, Swim Later, her debut extended play, in February 2025. Her breakthrough success came with the release of "Die on This Hill", which charted in numerous countries. She released her debut studio album, Visitor, on 3 July 2026, and achieved her first UK number one single with its track "Great Expectation".

nights.title: Freya Skye - Stars Align Tour in Singapore
nights.name: Freya Skye
nights.extract: Freya Skye is an English singer and actress. She represented the United Kingdom in the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2022, after which she was signed to Hollywood Records. Skye also has a talent holding deal for projects with Disney Branded Television. As an actress, she has appeared in The Next Step and made her film debut starring as Nova Bright in Zombies 4: Dawn of the Vampires. As a musician, Skye has released a number of singles since 2020 and released her debut extended play Stardust in 2026 and embarked on her first headlining tour, the Stars Align Tour.

nights.title: M2M: The TWO Tour 2027 – Singapore
nights.name: M2M
nights.extract: M2M is a Norwegian pop duo comprising Marit Larsen and Marion Raven. Larsen and Raven had been friends since the age of five and formed a music duo when they were eight. They released a children's album in 1996 when Larsen was 12 and Raven was 11, under the name "Marit & Marion". The album was nominated for a Spellemannprisen award and the band changed their name to M2M after signing a record deal with Atlantic Records in 1998. M2M were frequently praised for writing most of their songs and performing their own instruments, something that was considered to set them apart from the majority of teen pop music artists.

facts: Sie veröffentlichten 1996 ein Kinderalbum, als Larsen 12 und Raven 11 Jahre alt waren, unter dem Namen "Marit & Marion".

M2M, şarkılarının çoğunu kendileri yazmaları ve enstrümanlarını kendileri çalmaları nedeniyle sık sık övüldü; bu özellik onları çoğu genç pop sanatçısından ayıran bir unsur olarak görüldü.

nights.title: Bruno Mars - The Romantic Tour
nights.name: Bruno Mars
nights.extract: Peter Gene Hernandez, known professionally as Bruno Mars, is an American singer-songwriter, record producer and dancer. Regarded as a pop icon, he is known for his three-octave tenor vocal range, retro showmanship, musical versatility, and live performances, accompanied by his band, the Hooligans. Raised in Honolulu, Mars gained recognition in Hawaii as a child for his impersonation of Elvis Presley, before moving to Los Angeles in 2003 to pursue a musical career.
